question: Should OpenClaw adopt the stacked `includeFamily` API plus default-off `agents.defaults.experimental.sessionFamilyCarryover` behavior, and if so should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90239 land first or should this PR become the combined landing path?
rationale: No concrete correctness defect remains, but the change adds a public protocol/tool selector, persistent reset-lineage behavior, a new configuration surface, and an archived-context provider boundary; automation cannot choose those permanent product and security semantics.

options.title: Land the stack in order
options.body: Approve the API and provider-boundary semantics, land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90239 first, then rebase this PR to the carryover-only delta.

options.title: Use one combined landing
options.body: Resolve conflicts and intentionally review this PR as the canonical combined family-history and carryover implementation.

options.title: Keep retrieval only
options.body: Land explicit family-history retrieval but remove automatic prompt carryover, its config option, and ordinary-reset lineage additions from this PR.

recommendation.title: Land the stack in order
recommendation.body: Approve the API and provider-boundary semantics, land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90239 first, then rebase this PR to the carryover-only delta.

likelyOwner.reason: The discussion directly asks him to decide stack order and provider-boundary behavior, and he has recent history in the embedded-runner surface.
